cause_quote: The new warning helper used `const key = JSON.stringify([pluginId ?? null, params.family]);`, so the first deprecated method called by a plugin suppressed warnings for other methods in the same family.
user_saw: A plugin author could see migration guidance for the first deprecated SQLite SDK method their plugin called and miss the guidance for later calls to other methods in the same family.
summary: The fix gives each deprecated SQLite SDK method its own once-per-plugin-per-process warning, adds missing warnings, and corrects migration guidance.
reasoning: The introducing diff added the shared warning helper and gave `patchSessionEntry` and `updateSessionStoreEntry` distinct method names under the same `session-store` key, so the warnings collided from the start. The parent-side diff shows those two warning calls were new, and the later structured-notice commit kept the same family-only key for emitted warnings.
